statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Friday NQ price discovery ended near the session low after a meaningful rebound failed and a fresh late low formed.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES at the Friday close; the market is now closed, so subsequent weekend risk is described as gap and headline uncertainty until new tradable price-path evidence exists.
headline: Late NQ fade lifts Tail near the Friday close
body: The latest delayed September NQ quote was near 29,509.5 after a 29,468–29,704.5 session range. The late fade followed an earlier rebound and left futures near the session low, while Treasury yields remained elevated after strong payrolls. Semiconductor strength conflicted with a fully aligned bearish regime, limiting Tail to the elevated band.

lookbackSummary: Tail was elevated late on September 3, fell into low/watch bands overnight, stayed at WATCH around payrolls, rose to 28% on the delayed downside leg at 16:00 UTC, then eased as retracement returned before finishing the 20:00 UTC slot at low Tail.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are a weekend closed-market interval. Tail is projected to revert to low after the current closing-hour assessment because no new Nasdaq path can form; Stress remains high-to-extreme from rates, oil and geopolitical gap risk until tradable price discovery resumes.

forecast.analysis: The latest delayed September NQ quote was near 29,509.5, only about 42 points above the 29,468 session low after an earlier rebound. The late fade and fresh low support elevated Tail, while strong semiconductors keep cross-asset confirmation incomplete.
